sourceManifest.scope: Literal local import closure of this actual whole-annulus H runner.

sourceBinding.backgroundDefinition: Distinct enlarged b_n with actual n1 on its whole selected annulus band; canonical c_n and original coefficients are unchanged.
sourceBinding.operatorDefinition: Original palette, frozen leading reference, actual completed F/G phase and moving frame, pressure, exact Volterra limits and both Haar covariance columns.
sourceBinding.targetDefinition: Actual full leading source moments, original pressure datum and both shear terms; no supplied target vector.

domain.representativeDomain: Xrep in[Xa,Xb], etaRep in[-1,1], sRep in[1/2,2].
domain.covarianceDomain: Same original slow box with Euclidean distance<=4/S^3; both signs are columns of that box.
domain.positiveWeightDomain: Intersect the slow point with Xa<X<Xb; all nonzero stress positions in this open annulus.
domain.smoothSquareRootDomain: Interior eta/positive-time slow chart for fixed labels; eta endpoints use only original inward continuous jets. Flat radial extensions are separate.

sourceInputs.actualCutoffEnlargement: Source-bound normalized cutoff enlargement, finite block and all-n normalized induction.

sourceThreshold.producer: The same fixed source constants and condition formula as actual-covariance-operator-bounds.mjs. Its actual operator assembly is not replaced by this threshold calculation.

representativeRange.method: Positive reciprocal/square-root interval arithmetic: inverse reverses endpoints; all four product corners are retained, including signed constant coefficients.

sourceTransfer.scope: The same original actual coefficient family, every source-only b_n>=c_n doubling continuation, all integer ell>=ellMinimum, and one original slow box. The selected H roots below exercise one complete band of that family.
sourceTransfer.normalizedTransfer: For every q>0 the enlarged cutoff family is locally finite. The exact Euler-scale identity and b_n>=c_n preserve the actual n1/n2 C2 finite block and each original all-n diagonal bound. Thus the SAME constants control F,G and completed-leading slow C2 error O(q^(2h)).
sourceTransfer.chartPath: Use the straight path in [1/2,2]x[Xa/2,2Xb]x[-1,1] and its slow image. Subtraction of the two implicit s equations gives |Delta s|<=2(|Delta T|+4|Delta Z|); X and eta endpoint changes and chart path length are bounded by the source B. No convexity of the slow image is assumed.
sourceTransfer.sourceJetDifference: The fixed leading source C2 and completed-leading C2 bounds, same-box distance<=4/S^3, S^2*(epsilon+epsilon^2+k^-1)<=1 and B>=2^128 give |F-F0|,|F_R-F_R0|,|G_R-G_R0|<=B^5/S^3. The actual n1 term is bounded, not deleted.
sourceTransfer.frozenCancellation: pTilde*F_R0+pz*G_R0=beta dot(Rrep*F_R0,G_R0)=-sign*Bs*u/Ls by the exact leading N,K definitions.
sourceTransfer.rounding: p*k is the nearest nonzero integer with signed fallback in the zero cell; |p-pTilde|<=1/k. Only representative/source quantities enter the rounding, so every slow or pulse derivative of this label is zero.
sourceTransfer.tangentNormal: n_theta=p/R and n_z=pz-epsilon*v*(pF_Z+pzG_Z). Keep the original O(1/Ls) designed tilt, rounding, radial coordinate difference and entire epsilon*v term. Their total difference from Bs*K is <=B^12/S.
sourceTransfer.movingNormal: n_prime=(-phaseSpeed_R,0,-epsilon*phaseSpeed_Z); the same cancellation and scale inequalities give |n_prime|<=B^12/S.
sourceTransfer.denominators: Original leading source: F0>Renv^-10, |Ntheta|>Renv^-14, |g0|>Renv^-20, Renv^-6<|c0|<Renv^10, Renv^-31<lambda0<Renv^83. epsilon*k^2<=4 and u=2Renv^10 give Bs>Renv^-40>B^-1. S>=B^512 makes |n_tan-Bs*K|<=Bs/2 and hence |n_tan|>=B^-2. No finite H inversion is used to prove these primitive bounds.
sourceTransfer.referenceProjection: At nref=Bs*(sref,K), retain the full original cylindrical K0. Its n-prime-free projection in Uref=[e_r-sref*K,N] is [[0,2F0*Ntheta/(1+sref^2)],[-(gabs+2F0*Ntheta),0]]. The separate exact generic projection check proves this identity for every relevant unit frame.
sourceTransfer.referenceDiagonalization: The actual lambda0 sqrt radicand and c0=lambda0/(2F0*Ntheta) make J=[[1,1],[c0*sqrt(1+sref^2),-c0*sqrt(1+sref^2)]] diagonalize that reference to (+lambda,-lambda). Actual n-prime and B-prime stay in E_actual.
sourceTransfer.actualFrameError: The executed FramePowerLedger applies ordinary products, reciprocals with the preceding source lower bounds, square roots and v derivatives to the retained actual Aphi,B,Bleft,Bprime. Its calculated exponents are each <256. Therefore |E_actual_ij|, |d-dref|, |N_a-N|, |K_a-K| and |s_a-sref| are bounded by B^256/S.
sourceTransfer.damping: epsilon*k^2*Bs^2=lambda0/(1+u^2)^(3/2); therefore damping at the reference normal is exactly dref, and the actual normal difference gives the retained damping error.
sourceTransfer.unconditionalNorm: Before smallness is used, nonzero p*k and R<=B give 1/|n_tan|<=kB. The finite actual products and derivatives give ||wMatrix||_infinity<=B^40*(1+k)^3*(1+Ls)^2, dominated by the retained B^256*(1+k)^8*(1+Ls)^8.
sourceTransfer.targetDirection: The same actual full leading stress Tbar=s^(-A-1/2)*T0 and its closed-annulus unit-direction modulus are used. S>=Renv^1024 gives frozen target ratio variation<=kappa/16 inside the same box, including limiting directions at the two flat edges. Weight positivity below is claimed only where Xa<X<Xb and Tbar is nonzero.
sourceTransfer.allBandQualification: This is a written source-bound universal estimate for the explicitly defined locally finite enlarged source family. A finite selected-band execution is not a materialization of every band, a choice of all original physical cutoff clauses, or a decision of the original unspecified Gamma.

proof.band: The authenticated b1,b2 selection gives ell>=ellMinimum+12 and q<=qStar/128 throughout the selected physical band. S>=every source condition and S^2*(epsilon+epsilon^2+k^-1)<1 follow with original h>0.
proof.palette: For m=floor(((1+h)*ell*log2-2logell)/logTg), 1/(Tg*S)<ci<=1/S. Hence 2r0<=Ls/S<2r0*Tg for the actual source palette.
proof.exactSolutions: Each w is the exact Volterra limit of its retained actual moving-frame matrix, initial (1,0), and finite source matrix norm. The actual t=B*(P*w), pressure and n-prime/B-prime are preserved.
proof.radialMass: The source error bounds and Riccati cone give z_plus>0, |z_minus/z_plus|<=coneK/S<=1/2, and x=t_r>0. The original psi plateau and Gaussian curvature imply the displayed positive massLower; P<=1 implies massUpper.
proof.columns: The actual frame bounds and the continuous Gaussian absolute-moment estimate give |C-Cideal|_max<=kappa/128, Cideal=[[1,1],[-1,1]]. No finite pulse sample or asymptotic limit is substituted for its integral.
proof.determinant: The exact cone polynomial certificate gives 15/8<det C<17/8; det H=-Ac*u*mass_plus*mass_minus*det C<0. Thus the actual inverse denominators on the full declared annulus domain do not vanish.
proof.positiveWeights: For Xa<X<Xb, the unchanged full leading target and the source same-box direction modulus give targetScale=-(N dot Tbar)/Ac>0 and kappa/64<=mass_sign*y_sign/targetScale<=2. Both actual y_sign and their positive square roots satisfy the displayed bounds.
proof.interiorSmoothness: For fixed band and frozen labels, the actual finite coefficient body is smooth on the open slow chart; its compact-interval Volterra solution, H and full target have every finite slow derivative. Nonzero determinant and positive y imply smooth positive square roots in the interior. No derivative of a rounded label is included.
proof.universalNormScope: This is a written source-bound universal estimate for the explicitly defined locally finite enlarged source family. A finite selected-band execution is not a materialization of every band, a choice of all original physical cutoff clauses, or a decision of the original unspecified Gamma.
proof.remaining: Radial flat zero-extensions, coherent all-n original physical cutoff selection, every-band literal covariance roots and final paper Gamma remain separate. Eta endpoints use the original inward heat jets, not negative-time extension.

algebra.unitFrame: N=((t^2-1)/(1+t^2),2t/(1+t^2)), K=(-N_z,N_theta). For every source N_theta<0, t=N_z/(1-N_theta) gives this same frame.
algebra.referenceRelationsRequired: root^2=1+s^2, lambda0^2=-2F0*Ntheta*(gabs+2F0*Ntheta), c0=lambda0/(2F0*Ntheta), all required denominators nonzero.
algebra.pressureRetained: Reference n-prime is zero only in the algebraic reference comparison. Actual n-prime and B-prime remain in the source operator and its error estimate.
algebra.determinantIdentity: det(H)=-Ac*u*mass_plus*mass_minus*det(C). Positive masses and det(C)>0 give negative physical determinant.

cone.inwardProof: r_prime=E21+(-2*lambda+E22-E11)*r-E12*r^2. At r=+beta, beta=4E/(lambdaFloor*S)<=1, r_prime<=(E/S)*(1-8+2*beta+beta^2)<=-4E/S; the lower boundary is symmetric. E=0 gives r=0 exactly.
cone.positivity: z_plus is the positive exponential solution of its scalar equation after the invariant ratio is inserted; x=(1+r)*z_plus>0.

gaussian.continuousProof: u>=2 and u/2<=|s|<=3u/2 give lambdaLower/(2u) <= -Ls*(lambda-dref)_prime <= 7*lambdaUpper/u <= 15*lambdaUpper/u. The lower bound uses (5/4)^3<4. Integrate from the exact zero at v=Ls/2.

mass.lowerProof: For |v-Ls/2|<=sqrt(Ls)/(10a), a=max(1,2*gaussianUpper), psi=1 and P^2>=exp(-1/100)>1/3. Integrate over the interval of length sqrt(Ls)/(5a).
mass.upperProof: Extend the nonnegative integrand to the real line and set w=2*gaussianLower*(v-Ls/2)^2/Ls. The absolute first moment equals amplitudeUpper^2/(2*gaussianLower).

columns.normalizedRows: C_1sign=-(N dot H_sign)/(Ac*h_sign); C_2sign=(K dot H_sign)/(u*h_sign)
columns.tangentProof: Tangent-row error <=Es/(u*S)+(2+5*Ac/u)*Ef/S. Both reference normalized rows differ from their midpoint value by at most |v-Ls/2|/Ls; the factor u cancels.

selection.bandProof: ell>=ellMinimum>=Sminimum>=1 implies S=ell^2>=Sminimum. For ell>=(64/h)^2, log(3)+4log(ell)-(h*log(2)/2)*ell<0, using log(2)>=1/2 and log(ell)<=sqrt(ell). Hence S^2*(epsilon+epsilon^2+k^-1)<=3ell^4*2^(-h*ell/2)<1.
